parameters.query:
-- Odoo CRM stage change detect: compare crm.lead.stage_id (Odoo) against last-known stage in clients_master
SELECT
  cl.id AS odoo_lead_id,
  cl.name,
  cl.email_from AS email,
  cl.phone,
  cl.partner_name AS company,
  st.name AS current_stage,
  cm.status AS last_known_status
FROM crm_lead cl
JOIN crm_stage st ON st.id = cl.stage_id
LEFT JOIN clients_master cm ON cm.odoo_lead_id = cl.id
WHERE cm.odoo_lead_id IS NULL
   OR st.name != cm.status
ORDER BY cl.write_date DESC
LIMIT 25;

nodes.name: Detect CRM Stage Changes
nodes.notes: crm_lead aur crm_stage Odoo ke actual Postgres tables hain (same DB). st.name Odoo me aapke pipeline stages ke exact naam se match hone chahiye: New, Qualified, Contacted, Nurtured, Booked, Proposal Sent, Won, Onboarded, Delivered, Renewal - Section 1 wale funnel status ke mutabiq CRM pipeline stages rename kar lena.

INSERT INTO clients_master (odoo_lead_id, name, email, phone, company, status, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ({{$json.odoo_lead_id}}, {{JSON.stringify($json.name)}}, {{JSON.stringify($json.email)}}, {{JSON.stringify($json.phone)}}, {{JSON.stringify($json.company)}}, {{JSON.stringify($json.current_stage)}}, now(), now())
ON CONFLICT (odoo_lead_id) DO UPDATE
SET status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, odoo_lead_id, status AS current_stage;

nodes.name: Map Stage to Event Type
nodes.notes: S3.3 replacement for the 4 IF nodes. event_type=null (unmapped stage) still gets reported to the Hub — Hub-Dispatcher's default/no-match output (S2.4) logs it to flagged_events + Odoo Discuss alert, which is the same protection the old 'Detect Unmatched Stage' / 'Log Unmatched Stage Event' nodes gave (F3.1), now centralized in the Dispatcher instead of duplicated per-spoke.

nodes.name: Report to Hub
nodes.notes: S3.3 — replaces ALL of: 4x IF Stage=X, 4x Execute Workflow (2.1/2.4/2.5/2.7), Detect Unmatched Stage, Log Unmatched Stage Event, and Odoo Discuss - Notify Stage Change. The Dispatcher now owns routing + the unmatched-stage alert; 1.5's only job is detect-stage-change -> upsert -> tell the Hub what happened.
